notes.title: Update 1.0.0.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/9cc6f410a8f29519a2adacb4e4bc668e2f3ca198.png[/img]

1) The game now has collectible cards.

2) Now the film about the game is also available on VK: https://vk.com/video-147487802_456239304 (for those who can't watch it on YouTube) the film has already collected more than a million views.

3) Flashlight at the beginning of the game: Now we start the game without a flashlight.

4) Footstep sounds: The sound of footsteps in the apartment has been completely reworked. Now the sounds of bare feet on the floor convey a more realistic sense of the character's presence in space, creating a more tense atmosphere.

5) Cemetery and gates: A serious bug related to the gates to the cemetery has been fixed. Previously, players encountered a situation where the gate could block them against the wall, making it impossible to continue the game. Now these gates function correctly, allowing free movement.

6) Ammo stack in the hut: The error with the automatic combination of ammo in the forester's hut has been fixed.

7) Achievement "Rank C": The problem with the achievement "Rank C", which previously dropped extremely rarely or did not appear at all, has been fixed. Now the achievement is available upon fulfilling the corresponding conditions, which increases the motivation of players.

8) Opening Church Doors: The mechanism for opening church doors has been optimized.

9) Cutscenes: All cutscenes have been thoroughly reviewed and updated. It is especially important to note that enemies no longer attack the protagonist during certain scenes, ensuring a smooth passage.

10) Werewolf Cutscene: A common error that caused the werewolf scene to play multiple times in a row has been fixed. Now this scene works correctly and only once.

11) Abandoned House Door: An issue with the door in the abandoned house, which could get stuck or open incorrectly, has been fixed. The door now functions without glitches, allowing for unhindered exploration of the house.

12) Interactive Items: The mechanism for interacting with various items in the game has been improved. Now most items can be picked up much more easily, without having to repeatedly try to interact with them.

13) Grammatical Errors: The game text has been checked and edited. Several grammatical errors have been removed, making the game more professional and understandable.

14) Collectible Doll: The collectible doll behind the locker has been made easier to access. It is now in a more convenient place and can be easily picked up, which contributes to the successful collection of all game artifacts.

15) Mansion Light Source: An additional light source has been added to the mansion. Now, when the key is sticking out of the door lock, it can be seen much better thanks to a bright lamp, which simplifies the gameplay.

16) Flashlight Functionality: The flashlight has been improved. Now it illuminates the space in front of the player at the character's eye level, which makes exploring dark areas much more effective.

17) Mixing Ingredients: Fixed a bug related to mixing two mints when one of them disappeared.

18) Chainsaw Boss: Improved the AI ​​of the Chainsaw Boss. His critical attack now works consistently, adding complexity and variety to the battle.

19. Flashlight Light: We have significantly reduced the intensity of the flashlight light, reducing its brightness by half. This change is aimed at creating more realistic lighting in dark areas of the game, which helps to enhance the atmosphere.

20. Hair Shadow: In previous versions, the character's shadow looked unnatural, creating the illusion of a bald hero. Now I have added a shadow from the hair, which makes the character visually more alive.

21. Door Handle Display: In the entrance, errors were noticed with the display of door handles, which caused visual distortions. I carefully worked out this problem and updated the models so that the door handles look correct.

22. Mid-air collisions in the hospital: I found and fixed a bug that caused a mid-air collision in one of the key locations — the hospital area. Now players can move freely and use weapons without interference.

23. Grandpa's basement and the box with a gear: In Grandpa's basement, a visual inconsistency was found, when a whole gear would accidentally end up in a box with parts instead of a part. This issue has been fixed, now the game only has the necessary part.

24. English localization: A flaw was found in the game's opening splash screen: the English text was partially Russian.

25. Minor fixes: In addition to the improvements listed, I made many other minor adjustments and optimizations.

These changes are aimed at improving the gameplay, eliminating technical flaws and increasing the overall level of immersion in the game world.

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/c5929b442978d32ee91c7045317c2c50e1770be5.png[/img]

1. All ammo is now automatically stacked in the inventory, which greatly simplifies the gameplay. Players no longer need to waste time visiting the inventory frequently. This innovation contributes to a smoother and more continuous gameplay.

2. The ability to throw away a driver's license. The player can now get rid of the driver's license, freeing up space in the inventory.

3. Car keys can also be easily removed from the inventory. This update allows players to manage their inventory more flexibly and efficiently, getting rid of unnecessary items that are rarely used during the game.

4. Bridge repair boards have been moved to a more visible place. This optimization helps improve navigation through the game world.

5. Fixed a bug that prevented the inventory expansion achievement from being obtained. Players can now safely obtain this achievement by simply interacting with the first inventory expansion bag.

6. The first bag that expands the inventory has been moved to the first level of the village on the police car. This change makes the beginning of the game more friendly and understandable for newcomers.

7. Collision in various locations has been fixed: now objects in the game do not interfere with each other, which ensures more stable interaction between characters and the environment. As a result, the game becomes less annoying and more enjoyable.

8. Interactions at key points in the game world have been improved: now the character and objects interact with each other more naturally and realistically.

9. The sounds in the game have been improved and updated: new sound effects have been added, existing ones have been improved.

10. A bug related to the chest puzzle has been fixed.

11. Replaced music tracks with authorship on YouTube. Now you can safely stream the game.

notes.title: The release date has been postponed to May 25, 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/2939b2b0335f4d6c90174d1881e7e4c63c95d0bf.jpg[/img]

I apologize to everyone who was eagerly awaiting the game's release on Steam today! I really did everything I could to make it to today. Until the very last moment, I believed that a miracle would happen and we would receive the coveted approval from the platform.

Unfortunately, reality turned out to be tougher than expected - the game's release had to be postponed indefinitely due to delays in the review process.

The story began back in April, when I sent the game for review to Steam. At that time, it seemed that the process would go smoothly, because from the technical side everything was flawless. Unforeseen circumstances intervened in the form of comments regarding the Russian localization.
Steam drew attention to one specific place in the main menu interface, where the phrase "Exit to Windows" raised questions.

I carefully studied this situation and explained to Steam representatives that the use of the word "Windows" in English writing is an established practice in the Russian-language context of computer games and software.

This is because the word "Windows" has long been perceived as a brand, and not just a translation. The previous review took seven days, and although I have now received an explanation and made the necessary adjustments, the response time from Steam remains unpredictable.

I understand that each day of waiting seems like an eternity, especially for those who were looking forward to playing the game today. I promise that as soon as Steam approves the game, I will immediately announce the exact release dates. It may even happen earlier than expected, since we will make every effort to speed up the process.

Don't lose hope! To stay up to date with all the news and receive release notifications, be sure to add the game to your wishlist on Steam. This will allow you to be the first to know about the release and start playing. I appreciate your support and patience, and I promise to do my best to please you with a quality product and a pleasant gaming experience!

The release date has been postponed to May 25, 2025!

Sorry!

notes.title: EBOLA VILLAGE - new movie
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/437ac057356c1f632eef47da666b3e006f81316e.jpg[/img]

Great news, friends, they decided to remake the film based on the game EBOLA VILLAGE, the first batch of screenshots from the film. It will be released simultaneously with the game, and will be free. This means that fans of the game will be able to enjoy not only new adventures in the virtual world, but also see them live on the big screen. We promise that the film will not just be an adaptation of the game, but a full-fledged addition to the story, with new characters and storylines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/bc5d842ece26866e91d17d2402faaa5c909eccd8.jpg[/img]

The costumes for the actors were chosen well, we had to dig through many places in search of the right clothes and props. This was a real challenge for the whole team, because each element had to correspond to the era and style conceived by the director. Despite all the difficulties, the result was worth it: the actors looked like real characters on stage, and the audience will be completely immersed in the atmosphere of the performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/9b63f9004a6015b385006a9015da9d10d6287948.jpg[/img]

The brutality of the film will be off the charts by all canons of the genre, offering viewers immersion in a world where violence and cruelty are an integral part of everyday life. The director, known for his bold and provocative works, does not hesitate to show the darkest sides of human nature, making the film not only exciting, but also provocative. Every scene, every detail of the visual series is carefully thought out to enhance the feeling of realism and immersion in a world where brutality is the norm.

The actors chosen for the roles demonstrate the depth and complexity of their characters, making them not just one-dimensional heroes or villains, but living, breathing creatures with whom viewers can empathize or feel antipathy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/5c7136512b800c85868c7c9a57998143bd9aa623.jpg[/img]

The soundtrack, consisting of aggressive and dissonant sounds, adds even more tension and dynamics to the film, making the audience feel like they are part of what is happening on the screen. Visual effects, including special effects and makeup, also play a key role in creating the atmosphere of the film, making each scene as realistic and impressive as possible.

In the EBOLA VILLAGE game itself, we play as the wife Maria, and in the film we can see the husband's storyline and the background of the beginning of the epidemic. This interesting combination of media formats allows us to understand the story and characters more deeply, making the experience more complete and exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/3da96a0ce470c39aa1b32d79216225b701a7d108.jpg[/img]

Viewers will be able to enjoy a gripping plot and impressive scenes for almost half an hour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/3bc2435b7beb36a4b03b7a88bc06fd3025f01bcb.jpg[/img]

There will be a real iconic car that will add even more style and atmosphere to the film.

After all, the 1967 Impala is not just a car, it is a symbol of the era when rock and roll and cars were an integral part of American culture. The film will certainly show all the unique features of this car, including its powerful engine, luxurious interior and, of course, its famous exterior trim. Viewers will be able to enjoy every moment when the film's hero drives this car, feeling like a part of that era.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/b4039bcba9750bbd86873991c7324adacbfc1a92.jpg[/img]

In addition, the use of Chevrolet Impala in the film will also emphasize the theme of nostalgia and love for classic cars, which will certainly cause a lot of emotions in the audience. This will not be just a movie, but a real journey through time, where every frame will be filled with atmosphere and style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/33bd6ea0d25d8d901a08ca60f56a7210a05be5ab.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/bd25d9b274918856e5536d2a02f17459007bf4ac.jpg[/img]

Our film will feature real makeup, not CGI. We want every frame to be filled with realism and emotional depth, so we decided to abandon the use of CGI for special effects and makeup. Our team of professional makeup artists and costume designers work to create unique images for each character, using only natural materials and techniques. It is important to us that each actor feels as comfortable as possible in their image, so we spend a lot of time selecting and testing various makeup and costume options.

We are confident that this will allow the actors to fully embody their roles and convey the full range of emotions on screen. In addition, the use of natural makeup and costumes will add a special atmosphere and texture to our film that will distinguish it from modern blockbusters that rely on CGI. We want our viewers to feel like part of the world we are creating, and for every frame of the film to be filled with live energy and passion.

Our work on makeup and costumes will be one of the key elements in the success of our film, and we can’t wait to share the results with our viewers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/3d9a8a68bd614e77d780ee478356f6c71d50b376.jpg[/img]

A pyrotechnician was involved, so realistic shots and bullet hits on zombies will be visible. This will add additional dynamics and tension to the battle scenes, making them more exciting for the audience. Thanks to the professionalism of the pyrotechnician, every explosion, shot and flash will look so realistic that the audience will feel as if they are in the very center of apocalyptic chaos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/9164e79a0b84bce46f0280c3f01d0ac1d7e17b60.jpg[/img]

Our film involves bladed weapons, axes, knives. These objects not only add drama and tension to the fight scenes, but also play an important role in the development of the plot. Each of them has its own history and meaning, which makes them not just instruments of violence, but full-fledged characters in the world of the film. Axes, for example, symbolize strength and power, but also the danger that their use brings. They can be both a tool of defense and a weapon in the hands of villains. Knives are a more sophisticated and cunning way of fighting, requiring from the characters not only physical strength, but also dexterity and strategic thinking.

While working on the film, we paid special attention to the details and stories of each object. We wanted the audience to feel that each element in the world of the film has its own purpose and meaning, and is not just a decoration. This allowed us to create a deeper and more exciting plot that will keep the audience in suspense until the very end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/2939b2b0335f4d6c90174d1881e7e4c63c95d0bf.jpg[/img]

According to all the canons of the Survival Horror genre, our film will definitely have a shotgun, which will become a symbol of the main character's struggle against sinister forces. This powerful and fearsome shotgun will not only be the personification of courage and determination, but also a reminder that in a world where horror and chaos reign, it is important not only to survive, but also to preserve humanity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/1797ab42ccb15cf22698213836a4f0b3416537e3.jpg[/img]

Breaking a plate in our film is a ritual that gives +100 to the team's inspiration. This moment becomes a symbol of unity and readiness for new challenges. The whole team gathers around the broken plate, and each participant, in turn, takes a step forward, as if symbolizing their desire to overcome any obstacles on the path to success. At this moment, there is a special energy in the air, and everyone feels that they are not just colleagues, but a real team, ready to support each other in any situation.

Breaking a plate becomes not just a ritual, but a real catalyst that starts the process of transforming the team into a single organism capable of great things. After this moment, each team member feels more confident and motivated, ready to take on additional responsibilities and help others if needed. The plate breaking becomes a symbol of the fact that together they can achieve much more than each one separately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/126fb722155f01ea5d0288a0f5c1ea8836177e3c.jpg[/img]

The film is not without Easter eggs, pay attention to the woman in the background...

notes.title: EBOLA VILLAGE - list of updates.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43616350/c1243db9e5bec1145208b1dc99187c4530396ea4.png[/img]

I fixed all the remarks and bugs that I noticed while watching the streams (thanks for the feedback). But, please note, the DEMO version will not be updated!

After a couple of days, the DEMO will be deleted. Downloading an update is quite a long job, I'd rather spend that time developing a full game.

1) Fixed the animation of holding a shotgun in hand.
2) Added the ability to hit monsters with a butt.
3) Fixed monster physics.
4) Added monster death animations. (earlier shakes head)
5) When hit with a knife, cuts now remain, before there were holes.
6) Fixed navigation and a bug with a door in the first house.
7) Added a signature for the first 4 inventory slots, hotkeys for taking weapons.
8) Fixed a bug when we take down the monster's head, but he still manages to bite 1 time.
9) Grabs (bites) of zombies are now less common by 40% However, hand damage is increased by 15%.
10) Reduced HP of enemies.
11) Fixed a bug with the addition of M16, although we did not pick it up.
12) Fixed a bug when shooting close, before when we were bitten by monsters, the bullets flew past them.
13) Changed the sounds of the death of monsters. Also now they have a radius, and do not work on the entire map as before.
14) Added sounds of bleeding monsters.
15) Now some monsters can throw axes.
16) Changed the background and music in the main menu.

Also fixed a bug with saving the game. Previously, if we played and started a new game on a different difficulty level, the game was like completed. This error has been fixed.

However, I remind you that I do not update the demo version, it will be deleted soon. At the moment the game is in version 0.3.5, which is a rather raw product, the constant updating of the demo version takes a lot of time. The release product will be provided with at least version 1.0.0.

I am developing the game by myself. This demo is provided exclusively for the Steam Festival.
